records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the Metropolitan Police Service Dedicated Ward Officer Abstractions and Strengths dataset. It is aggregated to Team level per month and includes Month, BCU, Borough, Borough Code, Team, abstraction status/type and minutes. The official page states that a Ward Codes column was added on 27 November 2025, derived from team names and potentially not perfectly aligned to exact team areas. The current listed resource covers August 2021 through July 2026. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official dataset window; target-row extraction, geometry and parcel join are deferred to local OpenCode.
